name: Base44
tagline: Base44 is an AI platform for building fully functional apps with no code and minimal setup, generating a working product with database, backend, and UI from a plain-language description. Entrepreneurs and operations teams use it to create internal tools, customer-facing web apps, and workflow automations that would otherwise require a development team. Its no-infrastructure approach means users get a deployed, live application rather than just generated code that still needs to be hosted and maintained separately.
